cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
# Fall back to the conventional CUDA location when the caller did not pick a compiler
# (override via -DCMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER=... or the CUDACXX env var).
if (NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER AND NOT DEFINED ENV{CUDACXX} AND EXISTS /usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc)
    set(CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER /usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc)
endif ()
# Snapshot the caller's request BEFORE project(). project(LANGUAGES CUDA) always leaves
# CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES defined -- it falls back to the compiler's own default, which is 52 --
# so a test placed after it cannot tell "nothing was asked for" from "52 was asked for", and the
# default below never applied to a bare `cmake -S . -B build`: that produced a .so holding
# sm_52 alone, which no supported device can run. Left unset here on purpose, so project()'s
# compiler check still compiles for the default arch: seeding it with the Blackwell entries would
# make an old toolkit fail inside that check, with nvcc's own message, before the guard below can
# name the toolkit and the way out.
set(FAST_ULYSSES_ARCH_REQUESTED "${CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES}")
project(fast_ulysses LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 17)
if ("${FAST_ULYSSES_ARCH_REQUESTED}" STREQUAL "")
    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES "80;90;100;120")
else ()
    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES "${FAST_ULYSSES_ARCH_REQUESTED}")
endif ()
# Snapshot it HERE. find_package(Torch) below sets CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES to OFF and drives the
# arch selection from TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST via its own -gencode flags instead, so anything read
# after that point gets OFF rather than what was asked for.
set(FAST_ULYSSES_ARCH_LIST "${CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES}")
# Torch consumes a dotted form (90 -> 9.0). setup.py already exports this; set it for a plain
# cmake invocation too, otherwise -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES is silently ignored.
if (NOT DEFINED ENV{TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST})
    set(_arch_dotted "")
    foreach (a IN LISTS FAST_ULYSSES_ARCH_LIST)
        string(REGEX REPLACE "^(.+)(.)$" "\\1.\\2" _dotted "${a}")
        list(APPEND _arch_dotted "${_dotted}")
    endforeach ()
    string(REPLACE ";" " " _arch_dotted "${_arch_dotted}")
    set(ENV{TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST} "${_arch_dotted}")
endif ()

# ---- Is this toolkit new enough for the architectures that were asked for? ----
# Only Blackwell forces a floor: CUDA 12.6 and below cannot emit sm_100/sm_120 and nvcc says so
# with "unsupported gpu architecture 'compute_100'", which names neither the toolkit version nor
# the way out. Gated on the list, because FAST_ULYSSES_CUDA_ARCH=80;90 on CUDA 12.4 builds and
# runs -- docs/install.md states 12.8 as the supported floor, and this refuses only what nvcc
# provably cannot emit. Runs before the torch discovery, so it costs nothing.
#
# CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER_VERSION, not CUDAToolkit_VERSION: project(LANGUAGES CUDA) above already set
# it, and it is by construction the version of the nvcc named in the message. Reading it needs no
# find_package, so the guard cannot itself fail to resolve, and an unset version cannot make
# VERSION_LESS compare an empty string and abort a good toolkit.
set(_blackwell "")
foreach (a IN LISTS FAST_ULYSSES_ARCH_LIST)
    string(REGEX MATCH "^[0-9]+" _sm "${a}")  # 100a, 120-real -> 100, 120
    if (_sm AND _sm GREATER_EQUAL 100)
        list(APPEND _blackwell "sm_${_sm}")
    endif ()
endforeach ()
if (_blackwell AND CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER_VERSION VERSION_LESS 12.8)
    string(REPLACE ";" ", " _blackwell "${_blackwell}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
            "CUDA ${CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER_VERSION} (nvcc: ${CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER}) cannot compile "
            "for ${_blackwell}: Blackwell needs CUDA 12.8 or newer, and any CUDA 13 also "
            "qualifies.\n"
            "If the GPU you will run on is Blackwell, a newer toolkit is the only fix -- a .so "
            "without its arch loads and then fails at the first launch with 'no kernel image is "
            "available for execution on the device'.\n"
            "If it is not, drop the architectures this toolkit cannot emit:\n"
            "    FAST_ULYSSES_CUDA_ARCH=\"80;90\" pip install -e . --no-build-isolation\n"
            "Requested architectures: ${FAST_ULYSSES_ARCH_LIST}")
endif ()

# ccache: wrap CXX/CUDA compilers to cache objects and skip recompiling unchanged TUs (skipped if not installed)
find_program(CCACHE_PROGRAM ccache)
if (CCACHE_PROGRAM)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER "${CCACHE_PROGRAM}")
    set(CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER_LAUNCHER "${CCACHE_PROGRAM}")
    message(STATUS "ccache enabled: ${CCACHE_PROGRAM}")
endif ()

# Development.Module, not Development: the target below links Python::Module, which needs only the
# headers. Plain Development also demands libpython, which a manylinux CPython does not ship at all,
# so asking for it fails everywhere the release wheels are actually built.
find_package(Python COMPONENTS Interpreter Development.Module REQUIRED)
execute_process(
        COMMAND ${Python_EXECUTABLE} -c "import torch; print(torch.utils.cmake_prefix_path)"
        OUTPUT_VARIABLE TORCH_CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE)
set(CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "${TORCH_CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH}" CACHE STRING "Torch prefix" FORCE)
find_package(Torch REQUIRED)

# ---- Does this libtorch have c10d::register_work? ----
# It is what binds an async result's completion event to torch's work registry, which is how
# the caller gets an AsyncCollectiveTensor (wait_tensor finds the event) instead of a handle
# nothing forces them to wait on. Probe the LIBRARY, not the header: a declaration says
# nothing about what libtorch_cpu exports, and the substring below is the mangled
# c10d::register_work(const at::Tensor&, const c10::intrusive_ptr<c10d::Work>&).
# Unquoted ${CMAKE_NM}: if it is unset, the command fails and RESULT_VARIABLE says so rather
# than CMake erroring on an empty COMMAND. Missing it is not fatal -- src/work.cc then orders
# the result eagerly and group.py hands back a CompletedHandle instead.
find_library(TORCH_CPU_LIBRARY torch_cpu PATHS "${TORCH_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
execute_process(COMMAND ${CMAKE_NM} -D --defined-only "${TORCH_CPU_LIBRARY}"
        OUTPUT_VARIABLE TORCH_CPU_SYMBOLS RESULT_VARIABLE NM_STATUS ERROR_QUIET)
set(HAVE_C10D_REGISTER_WORK OFF)
if (NM_STATUS EQUAL 0)
    string(FIND "${TORCH_CPU_SYMBOLS}" "_ZN4c10d13register_workERKN2at6Tensor" REGISTER_WORK_AT)
    if (NOT REGISTER_WORK_AT EQUAL -1)
        set(HAVE_C10D_REGISTER_WORK ON)
    endif ()
endif ()
message(STATUS "c10d::register_work available: ${HAVE_C10D_REGISTER_WORK}")

if (NOT DEFINED EXT_SUFFIX)
    set(EXT_SUFFIX ".so")
endif ()

# One version literal, in ./VERSION. Read it here so a bare `cmake -S . -B build` bakes the same
# string the Python side reports; setup.py overrides it with the full version including any local
# tag.
if (NOT DEFINED FAST_ULYSSES_VERSION)
    file(STRINGS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/VERSION" FAST_ULYSSES_VERSION LIMIT_COUNT 1)
endif ()
# Re-run configure when the literal is bumped, so the baked macro cannot go stale.
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/VERSION")


file(GLOB SOURCES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cc" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cu")
add_library(_C SHARED ${SOURCES})
set_target_properties(_C PROPERTIES PREFIX "" SUFFIX "${EXT_SUFFIX}"
        CUDA_SEPARABLE_COMPILATION OFF CUDA_ARCHITECTURES "${FAST_ULYSSES_ARCH_LIST}")
# What build_info() reports. The arch list is worth carrying in the binary: a .so built without
# this GPU's arch fails in a way that does not mention arch.
#
# Comma-separated, because a CMake list expands with semicolons and target_compile_definitions
# would read those as separate definitions.
string(REPLACE ";" "," _arch_csv "${FAST_ULYSSES_ARCH_LIST}")
target_compile_definitions(_C PRIVATE
        FAST_ULYSSES_VERSION="${FAST_ULYSSES_VERSION}"
        FAST_ULYSSES_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="${_arch_csv}")
target_include_directories(_C PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
find_library(TORCH_PYTHON_LIBRARY torch_python PATHS "${TORCH_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(_C PRIVATE ${TORCH_LIBRARIES} ${TORCH_PYTHON_LIBRARY} Python::Module)
# torch's own lib directory is the only thing this links that is not on a default search path.
# Relative to $ORIGIN (= <site-packages>/fast_ulysses) so the wheel stays relocatable, and left as
# DT_RUNPATH -- no --disable-new-dtags -- so LD_LIBRARY_PATH can still override it.
set_target_properties(_C PROPERTIES BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH ON
        INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN/../torch/lib")
if (HAVE_C10D_REGISTER_WORK)
    target_compile_definitions(_C PRIVATE FAST_ULYSSES_HAS_WORK_REGISTRY=1)
else ()
    message(WARNING "c10d::register_work not found in ${TORCH_CPU_LIBRARY}: the async calls will "
            "return a CompletedHandle instead of an AsyncCollectiveTensor, with the caller's stream "
            "made to wait at launch -- correct, but no overlap.")
    target_compile_definitions(_C PRIVATE FAST_ULYSSES_HAS_WORK_REGISTRY=0)
endif ()
# -t0: nvcc compiles the per-arch device passes in parallel (one thread per arch)
target_compile_options(_C PRIVATE
        $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3 -t0 --expt-relaxed-constexpr>)

14	import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
15	from torch.distributed._functional_collectives import AsyncCollectiveTensor
16	
17	from . import _C
18

20	class CompletedHandle:
21	    """What the async call returns on a build whose libtorch has no ``c10d::register_work``. With
22	    no registry to bind the completion event to, the C++ side has already made the caller's stream
23	    wait on it, so ``wait()`` only unwraps -- a distinct type so that is visible."""

26	        self._tensor = tensor
27	
28	    def wait(self) -> torch.Tensor:

30

36	    """Ulysses all-to-all over NVLink, moved by the copy engines.
37	
38	    Construction is collective over ``process_group``. Windows are allocated on the first call that
39	    needs one and cached, so every rank must issue the same sequence of shapes. Contract:
40	    docs/api.md.
41	    """
42	
43	    def __init__(
44	        self,
45	        process_group: dist.ProcessGroup | None = None,
46	        device: torch.device | str | int | None = None,
47	        *,
48	        require_nvlink: bool = True,
49	    ) -> None:
50	        """
51	        Args:
52	            process_group: the group this collective runs over; ``None`` uses ``dist.group.WORLD``.
53	            device: this rank's CUDA device, as anything ``torch.device`` accepts; ``None`` and a
54	                device with no index both use the current device.
55	            require_nvlink: refuse a group whose GPUs are not all NVLink-joined. ``False`` is for
56	                measuring that case, not for running in it.
57	        """
58	        # Before anything that can throw: a refused construction -- a non-NVLink group, a device
59	        # that is not CUDA -- still leaves an object for __del__ to run on, with nothing to

61	        self._destroyed = True
62	        pg = process_group if process_group is not None else dist.group.WORLD
63	        self.pg = pg
64	        self.rank = dist.get_rank(pg)
65	        self.world_size = dist.get_world_size(pg)
66	        # Normalised, because everything below indexes `device.index`: a bare "cuda:0" string has
67	        # no .index attribute, and torch.device("cuda") has one that is None. Both used to fail
68	        # several lines later, on a message about neither the device nor this constructor.
69	        device = torch.device("cuda" if device is None else device)
70	        if device.type != "cuda":

72	        if device.index is None:
73	            device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
74	        self.device = device
75	        torch.cuda.set_device(device)

77	        if require_nvlink:

79	
80	        # Registers the group with torch's symmetric-memory bootstrap, which rendezvous needs. It
81	        # is idempotent, and deprecated from torch 2.13 (where rendezvous resolves the group by

83	        with warnings.catch_warnings():
84	            warnings.simplefilter("ignore", FutureWarning)
85	            symm_mem.enable_symm_mem_for_group(pg.group_name)
86	
87	        self._handle = torch.classes.fast_ulysses.UlyssesGroup(
88	            pg.group_name, int(self.rank), int(self.world_size), int(device.index)
89	        )
90	
91	        # High-priority stream for the async call only; the sync call stays on the caller's stream,
92	        # since routing it through here costs two event hops. The two streams are NOT ordered
93	        # against each other, which is why the C++ side gives them separate windows.
94	        _, greatest = torch.cuda.Stream.priority_range()
95	        self._comm_stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=device, priority=greatest)

98	    def _require_nvlink(self) -> None:
99	        """Every rank checks the same set of devices, so the answer is identical on all of them and

101	        local = torch.tensor([self.device.index], dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)

103	        dist.all_gather(gathered, local, group=self.pg)
104	        devices = [int(t.item()) for t in gathered]
105	        if len(set(devices)) != len(devices):
106	            return  # more than one rank per GPU: not a topology this check is about
107	        problem = _C.check_nvlink(devices)

112	        self,
113	        x: torch.Tensor,
114	        *,
115	        mode: int = 0,
116	        out: torch.Tensor | None = None,
117	        seq_splits: list[int] | None = None,
118	        head_splits: list[int] | None = None,
119	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
120	        """mode 0 scatters heads and gathers sequence; mode 1 inverts it.
121	
122	        Returns a tensor the caller owns, with no lifetime rules. ``out`` from ``empty_output()``
123	        skips the copy-out; any other contiguous CUDA tensor of the output shape is copied into.
124	
125	        ``seq_splits[p]`` / ``head_splits[p]`` are rank p's sequence and head shard: pass both or
126	        neither, identical on every rank and matching the shape handed in. Neither means even
127	        shards. Collective: every rank must issue the same sequence of shapes.
128	        """
129	        if out is None:
130	            return torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d(
131	                self._handle, x, mode, seq_splits, head_splits
132	            )
133	        # Refused rather than silently wrong, for the same reason the async call refuses: the
134	        # out-variant mutates a buffer the caller already owns, so it carries no autograd formula
135	        # and what comes back is that buffer -- backward() would run to completion and leave
136	        # x.grad as None. The returned value cannot signal it either, since nothing distinguishes
137	        # a caller who wanted no gradient from one whose gradient was dropped.
138	        if torch.is_grad_enabled() and x.requires_grad:
139	            raise RuntimeError(
140	                "all_to_all_4d(out=...) does not support autograd: the out-variant is a mutating "
141	                "op with no backward, so the gradient would be dropped without an error. Drop "
142	                "out=, or run under torch.no_grad()."
143	            )
144	        # Two ops, one method: the out-variant declares the alias it really has, which is what
145	        # keeps the functional one differentiable. See the note in src/bindings.cc.
146	        torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d_out(
147	            self._handle, x, mode, seq_splits, head_splits, out
148	        )
149	        return out
150	
151	    def all_to_all_4d_async(
152	        self,
153	        x: torch.Tensor,
154	        *,
155	        mode: int = 0,
156	        out: torch.Tensor | None = None,
157	        seq_splits: list[int] | None = None,
158	        head_splits: list[int] | None = None,
159	        lend: bool = False,
160	    ) -> torch.Tensor | CompletedHandle:
161	        """``all_to_all_4d`` on this group's comm stream, returning immediately.
162	
163	        The result is an ``AsyncCollectiveTensor``: ``.wait()`` returns the plain tensor, and so
164	        does the first use by any aten op -- either way the caller's stream waits on the comm
165	        stream's completion event GPU-side, and the host does not block. A view op re-wraps without
166	        waiting.
167	
168	        ``lend=True`` gets ``out=``'s saving without a buffer of your own: the peers write a window
169	        this group holds, the result IS that window, and there is no copy-out. The group rotates
170	        through four windows per dtype, so at most four lent results may be alive at once -- a
171	        fifth call raises rather than overwriting one, and the count is per rank, so every rank has
172	        to drop its results at the same point in its own program. Mutually exclusive with ``out=``.
173	        Like the rest of this method it is not differentiable.
174	
175	        Wait on, or use, every result: a dropped one leaves its entry in torch's work registry, and
176	        ``out=`` is the hole, since reading your own ``out`` never touches the registry. On a
177	        libtorch with no ``c10d::register_work`` this returns a ``CompletedHandle`` instead --
178	        correct, no overlap, and a distinct type so it is visible.
179	        """
180	        # Refused rather than silently ignored: both ask for the zero-copy path, and picking one
181	        # for the caller would leave a lend=True that quietly did nothing.
182	        if out is not None and lend:
183	            raise ValueError(
184	                "all_to_all_4d_async takes out= or lend=True, not both: each is a way of getting "
185	                "the zero-copy path, one with a buffer you own and one with a window the group "
186	                "lends. Drop whichever you did not mean."
187	            )
188	        # Refused rather than silently wrong. AsyncCollectiveTensor is built with
189	        # _make_wrapper_subclass(..., requires_grad=elem.requires_grad), which makes the wrapper a
190	        # LEAF: autograd runs above the subclass and never sees the wrapped tensor's history, so
191	        # backward() would deposit the gradient on the wrapper and leave x.grad as None.
192	        if torch.is_grad_enabled() and x.requires_grad:
193	            raise RuntimeError(
194	                "all_to_all_4d_async does not support autograd: its result is an "
195	                "AsyncCollectiveTensor, which is a leaf, so the gradient would be dropped without "
196	                "an error. Use all_to_all_4d()."
197	            )
198	        # This group's device, not the current one: an aten op on `x` runs on the current stream
199	        # of x's device whatever device is current, and that stream is what the transfer has to be
200	        # ordered against. With another device current, the no-argument form names a stream on it,
201	        # which orders nothing here and cannot take record_stream() for this tensor.
202	        caller = torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device)
203	        with torch.cuda.stream(self._comm_stream):
204	            if out is None:
205	                y = torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d_staged(
206	                    self._handle,
207	                    x,
208	                    mode,
209	                    seq_splits,
210	                    head_splits,
211	                    caller.stream_id,
212	                    caller.device_index,
213	                    lend,
214	                )
215	            else:
216	                torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d_staged_out(
217	                    self._handle,
218	                    x,
219	                    mode,
220	                    seq_splits,
221	                    head_splits,
222	                    out,
223	                    caller.stream_id,
224	                    caller.device_index,
225	                )
226	                y = out
227	        registered = _C.register_stream_completion(y, self._comm_stream.cuda_stream)
228	        # Two streams touch the output: one allocated it, the other wrote it, and the caching
229	        # allocator must know about the cross-stream use before it may recycle the block.
230	        y.record_stream(self._comm_stream)
231	        y.record_stream(caller)
232	        return AsyncCollectiveTensor(y) if registered else CompletedHandle(y)
233	
234	    def empty_output(
235	        self,
236	        x: torch.Tensor,
237	        *,
238	        mode: int = 0,
239	        seq_splits: list[int] | None = None,
240	        head_splits: list[int] | None = None,
241	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
242	        """A buffer shaped like ``all_to_all_4d(x, mode=...)``'s output, in symmetric memory.
243	
244	        Passing it back as ``out=`` makes the peers write it directly, which removes the copy-out.
245	        You own it: keep it across steps, free it when you like, and it may outlive the group.
246	        COLLECTIVE, so allocate outside the loop -- and use one buffer per concurrent call, since a
247	        call overwrites it.
248	        """
249	        return torch.ops.fast_ulysses.empty_output(self._handle, x, mode, seq_splits, head_splits)
250	
251	    def _timed(
252	        self,
253	        x: torch.Tensor,
254	        *,
255	        mode: int = 0,
256	        seq_splits: list[int] | None = None,
257	        head_splits: list[int] | None = None,
258	    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, float]]:
259	        """BENCHMARKS ONLY: the copying call with CUDA events between its stages, which sum to the
260	        whole call because they are strictly ordered on one stream. Reading the events syncs."""
261	        out, stages = torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d_timed(
262	            self._handle, x, mode, seq_splits, head_splits
263	        )
264	        names = ("barrier_in", "transfer", "barrier_out", "copy_out")
265	        return out, dict(zip(names, (float(v) for v in stages), strict=True))
266	
267	    def destroy(self) -> None:
268	        """Release the group's windows and its transfer stream. Collective: dropping a window is.
269	        Buffers from ``empty_output()`` are unaffected -- they are yours."""
270	        if self._destroyed:
271	            return
272	        # Drain the comm stream first: dist.barrier only syncs the caller's current stream, so an
273	        # unwaited async call could still be writing a window that is about to be freed.
274	        self._comm_stream.synchronize()
275	        dist.barrier(group=self.pg)
276	        self._handle.destroy()
277	        self._destroyed = True
278	
279	    def __del__(self) -> None:
280	        # A group that is dropped rather than destroyed still has to outlive its own transfers.
281	        # The handle's C++ destructor waits on the internal transfer stream but knows nothing of
282	        # this one, so an unwaited async call could still be writing a window as it is freed.
283	        # There is no barrier here on purpose: a finalizer is no place for a collective, which is
284	        # why destroy() and not this is the supported path.
285	        if not self._destroyed:
286	            self._comm_stream.synchronize()

"""The Python surface: a constructor, two collectives, and an output allocator.

Everything that survives a call -- the symmetric windows, the cached plans, the staging buffers --
lives in C++ (src/group.cc). What stays here is what has no C++ equivalent: the process group's
name, the comm stream, and ``AsyncCollectiveTensor``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import warnings

import torch
import torch.distributed as dist
import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
from torch.distributed._functional_collectives import AsyncCollectiveTensor

from . import _C


class CompletedHandle:
    """What the async call returns on a build whose libtorch has no ``c10d::register_work``. With
    no registry to bind the completion event to, the C++ side has already made the caller's stream
    wait on it, so ``wait()`` only unwraps -- a distinct type so that is visible."""

    def __init__(self, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> None:
        self._tensor = tensor

    def wait(self) -> torch.Tensor:
        return self._tensor

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"CompletedHandle({tuple(self._tensor.shape)}, {self._tensor.dtype})"


class UlyssesGroup:
    """Ulysses all-to-all over NVLink, moved by the copy engines.

    Construction is collective over ``process_group``. Windows are allocated on the first call that
    needs one and cached, so every rank must issue the same sequence of shapes. Contract:
    docs/api.md.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        process_group: dist.ProcessGroup | None = None,
        device: torch.device | str | int | None = None,
        *,
        require_nvlink: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Args:
            process_group: the group this collective runs over; ``None`` uses ``dist.group.WORLD``.
            device: this rank's CUDA device, as anything ``torch.device`` accepts; ``None`` and a
                device with no index both use the current device.
            require_nvlink: refuse a group whose GPUs are not all NVLink-joined. ``False`` is for
                measuring that case, not for running in it.
        """
        # Before anything that can throw: a refused construction -- a non-NVLink group, a device
        # that is not CUDA -- still leaves an object for __del__ to run on, with nothing to
        # release.
        self._destroyed = True
        pg = process_group if process_group is not None else dist.group.WORLD
        self.pg = pg
        self.rank = dist.get_rank(pg)
        self.world_size = dist.get_world_size(pg)
        # Normalised, because everything below indexes `device.index`: a bare "cuda:0" string has
        # no .index attribute, and torch.device("cuda") has one that is None. Both used to fail
        # several lines later, on a message about neither the device nor this constructor.
        device = torch.device("cuda" if device is None else device)
        if device.type != "cuda":
            raise ValueError(f"device must be a CUDA device, got {device}")
        if device.index is None:
            device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
        self.device = device
        torch.cuda.set_device(device)

        if require_nvlink:
            self._require_nvlink()

        # Registers the group with torch's symmetric-memory bootstrap, which rendezvous needs. It
        # is idempotent, and deprecated from torch 2.13 (where rendezvous resolves the group by
        # itself) -- calling it anyway is what keeps 2.10 working.
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("ignore", FutureWarning)
            symm_mem.enable_symm_mem_for_group(pg.group_name)

        self._handle = torch.classes.fast_ulysses.UlyssesGroup(
            pg.group_name, int(self.rank), int(self.world_size), int(device.index)
        )

        # High-priority stream for the async call only; the sync call stays on the caller's stream,
        # since routing it through here costs two event hops. The two streams are NOT ordered
        # against each other, which is why the C++ side gives them separate windows.
        _, greatest = torch.cuda.Stream.priority_range()
        self._comm_stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=device, priority=greatest)
        self._destroyed = False

    def _require_nvlink(self) -> None:
        """Every rank checks the same set of devices, so the answer is identical on all of them and
        the refusal is collective in practice."""
        local = torch.tensor([self.device.index], dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)
        gathered = [torch.zeros_like(local) for _ in range(self.world_size)]
        dist.all_gather(gathered, local, group=self.pg)
        devices = [int(t.item()) for t in gathered]
        if len(set(devices)) != len(devices):
            return  # more than one rank per GPU: not a topology this check is about
        problem = _C.check_nvlink(devices)
        if problem:
            raise RuntimeError(problem)

    def all_to_all_4d(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        *,
        mode: int = 0,
        out: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        seq_splits: list[int] | None = None,
        head_splits: list[int] | None = None,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """mode 0 scatters heads and gathers sequence; mode 1 inverts it.

        Returns a tensor the caller owns, with no lifetime rules. ``out`` from ``empty_output()``
        skips the copy-out; any other contiguous CUDA tensor of the output shape is copied into.

        ``seq_splits[p]`` / ``head_splits[p]`` are rank p's sequence and head shard: pass both or
        neither, identical on every rank and matching the shape handed in. Neither means even
        shards. Collective: every rank must issue the same sequence of shapes.
        """
        if out is None:
            return torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d(
                self._handle, x, mode, seq_splits, head_splits
            )
        # Refused rather than silently wrong, for the same reason the async call refuses: the
        # out-variant mutates a buffer the caller already owns, so it carries no autograd formula
        # and what comes back is that buffer -- backward() would run to completion and leave
        # x.grad as None. The returned value cannot signal it either, since nothing distinguishes
        # a caller who wanted no gradient from one whose gradient was dropped.
        if torch.is_grad_enabled() and x.requires_grad:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "all_to_all_4d(out=...) does not support autograd: the out-variant is a mutating "
                "op with no backward, so the gradient would be dropped without an error. Drop "
                "out=, or run under torch.no_grad()."
            )
        # Two ops, one method: the out-variant declares the alias it really has, which is what
        # keeps the functional one differentiable. See the note in src/bindings.cc.
        torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d_out(
            self._handle, x, mode, seq_splits, head_splits, out
        )
        return out

    def all_to_all_4d_async(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        *,
        mode: int = 0,
        out: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        seq_splits: list[int] | None = None,
        head_splits: list[int] | None = None,
        lend: bool = False,
    ) -> torch.Tensor | CompletedHandle:
        """``all_to_all_4d`` on this group's comm stream, returning immediately.

        The result is an ``AsyncCollectiveTensor``: ``.wait()`` returns the plain tensor, and so
        does the first use by any aten op -- either way the caller's stream waits on the comm
        stream's completion event GPU-side, and the host does not block. A view op re-wraps without
        waiting.

        ``lend=True`` gets ``out=``'s saving without a buffer of your own: the peers write a window
        this group holds, the result IS that window, and there is no copy-out. The group rotates
        through four windows per dtype, so at most four lent results may be alive at once -- a
        fifth call raises rather than overwriting one, and the count is per rank, so every rank has
        to drop its results at the same point in its own program. Mutually exclusive with ``out=``.
        Like the rest of this method it is not differentiable.

        Wait on, or use, every result: a dropped one leaves its entry in torch's work registry, and
        ``out=`` is the hole, since reading your own ``out`` never touches the registry. On a
        libtorch with no ``c10d::register_work`` this returns a ``CompletedHandle`` instead --
        correct, no overlap, and a distinct type so it is visible.
        """
        # Refused rather than silently ignored: both ask for the zero-copy path, and picking one
        # for the caller would leave a lend=True that quietly did nothing.
        if out is not None and lend:
            raise ValueError(
                "all_to_all_4d_async takes out= or lend=True, not both: each is a way of getting "
                "the zero-copy path, one with a buffer you own and one with a window the group "
                "lends. Drop whichever you did not mean."
            )
        # Refused rather than silently wrong. AsyncCollectiveTensor is built with
        # _make_wrapper_subclass(..., requires_grad=elem.requires_grad), which makes the wrapper a
        # LEAF: autograd runs above the subclass and never sees the wrapped tensor's history, so
        # backward() would deposit the gradient on the wrapper and leave x.grad as None.
        if torch.is_grad_enabled() and x.requires_grad:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "all_to_all_4d_async does not support autograd: its result is an "
                "AsyncCollectiveTensor, which is a leaf, so the gradient would be dropped without "
                "an error. Use all_to_all_4d()."
            )
        # This group's device, not the current one: an aten op on `x` runs on the current stream
        # of x's device whatever device is current, and that stream is what the transfer has to be
        # ordered against. With another device current, the no-argument form names a stream on it,
        # which orders nothing here and cannot take record_stream() for this tensor.
        caller = torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device)
        with torch.cuda.stream(self._comm_stream):
            if out is None:
                y = torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d_staged(
                    self._handle,
                    x,
                    mode,
                    seq_splits,
                    head_splits,
                    caller.stream_id,
                    caller.device_index,
                    lend,
                )
            else:
                torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d_staged_out(
                    self._handle,
                    x,
                    mode,
                    seq_splits,
                    head_splits,
                    out,
                    caller.stream_id,
                    caller.device_index,
                )
                y = out
        registered = _C.register_stream_completion(y, self._comm_stream.cuda_stream)
        # Two streams touch the output: one allocated it, the other wrote it, and the caching
        # allocator must know about the cross-stream use before it may recycle the block.
        y.record_stream(self._comm_stream)
        y.record_stream(caller)
        return AsyncCollectiveTensor(y) if registered else CompletedHandle(y)

    def empty_output(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        *,
        mode: int = 0,
        seq_splits: list[int] | None = None,
        head_splits: list[int] | None = None,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """A buffer shaped like ``all_to_all_4d(x, mode=...)``'s output, in symmetric memory.

        Passing it back as ``out=`` makes the peers write it directly, which removes the copy-out.
        You own it: keep it across steps, free it when you like, and it may outlive the group.
        COLLECTIVE, so allocate outside the loop -- and use one buffer per concurrent call, since a
        call overwrites it.
        """
        return torch.ops.fast_ulysses.empty_output(self._handle, x, mode, seq_splits, head_splits)

    def _timed(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        *,
        mode: int = 0,
        seq_splits: list[int] | None = None,
        head_splits: list[int] | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, float]]:
        """BENCHMARKS ONLY: the copying call with CUDA events between its stages, which sum to the
        whole call because they are strictly ordered on one stream. Reading the events syncs."""
        out, stages = torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d_timed(
            self._handle, x, mode, seq_splits, head_splits
        )
        names = ("barrier_in", "transfer", "barrier_out", "copy_out")
        return out, dict(zip(names, (float(v) for v in stages), strict=True))

    def destroy(self) -> None:
        """Release the group's windows and its transfer stream. Collective: dropping a window is.
        Buffers from ``empty_output()`` are unaffected -- they are yours."""
        if self._destroyed:
            return
        # Drain the comm stream first: dist.barrier only syncs the caller's current stream, so an
        # unwaited async call could still be writing a window that is about to be freed.
        self._comm_stream.synchronize()
        dist.barrier(group=self.pg)
        self._handle.destroy()
        self._destroyed = True

    def __del__(self) -> None:
        # A group that is dropped rather than destroyed still has to outlive its own transfers.
        # The handle's C++ destructor waits on the internal transfer stream but knows nothing of
        # this one, so an unwaited async call could still be writing a window as it is freed.
        # There is no barrier here on purpose: a finalizer is no place for a collective, which is
        # why destroy() and not this is the supported path.
        if not self._destroyed:
            self._comm_stream.synchronize()

14	///
15	/// Remote peers are serialised on `xfer` because they all leave through the same egress and
16	/// separate streams would only make them contend; this rank's own share crosses no link and runs
17	/// on `stream` alongside them. The transfer is joined back onto `stream` before returning.
18	///
19	/// The zero-SM property is a property of the REMOTE copies: a peer copy overlaps concurrent compute,
20	/// while a same-device copy competes with it for the same memory system. This rank's own share is a
21	/// same-device copy, and so is the copy-out on the copying path.
22	///
23	/// @param src        base of this rank's input tensor
24	/// @param peer_ptrs  peer p's window base, as addressed from this rank; `plan.ops` offsets are
25	///                   relative to it. Its size is the world size.
26	/// @param plan       what this rank sends, from build_plan()
27	/// @param xfer       the group's dedicated transfer stream
28	/// @param rank       this rank's index within `peer_ptrs`
29	/// @param stream     the caller's stream

31	                   const std::vector<uint64_t>& peer_ptrs,
32	                   const A2APlan&               plan,
33	                   cudaStream_t                 xfer,
34	                   int                          rank,
35	                   cudaStream_t                 stream);

37	/// @brief Barrier across the group, over P2P-accessible flags.
38	///
39	/// A one-block spin kernel: rank r publishes its epoch into every peer's `flags[r]` with a release
40	/// store, then waits until its own `flags[0..ws-1]` have all reached that epoch. The epoch lives on
41	/// the device and is advanced by the kernel, so a captured graph advances it on replay too -- a
42	/// host-computed epoch would bake a constant into the graph and every replay would be satisfied by
43	/// stale state.
44	///
45	/// The layout inside each rank's flag region is `uint64 flags[ws]` followed by `uint64 epoch`, so
46	/// the caller must provide at least `(ws + 1) * 8` bytes and zero them before the first call.
47	///

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import shlex
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import sysconfig
from pathlib import Path

from setuptools import Extension, setup
from setuptools.command.build_ext import build_ext

_HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
os.chdir(_HERE)

# Relative to build_lib (and to the wheel root); the source tree keeps the package under python/.
_BUILD_META = Path("fast_ulysses") / "_build_meta.py"
_PKG_DIR = _HERE / "python" / "fast_ulysses"


def _base_version() -> str:
    """The one version literal, read out of ./VERSION.

    CMake reads the same file, and setup.py bakes it into _build_meta.py, which is where the
    installed package reads __version__ from.
    """
    return (_HERE / "VERSION").read_text().strip()


def _build_jobs(arch: str) -> int:
    """How many translation units to compile at once, bounded by MEMORY, not just cores.

    Each job forks one nvcc, and -t0 makes that nvcc run one device pass per architecture at the
    same time, so peak concurrency is jobs * len(arch) and peak memory scales with it. A small CI
    runner is killed by the OOM reaper partway through a four-architecture build if -j follows the
    core count alone. Budget 3 GiB per concurrent pass. Falls back to the core count where
    MemAvailable is not readable; CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL overrides either way.
    """
    cpus = os.cpu_count() or 1
    n_arch = max(1, len([a for a in arch.split(";") if a]))
    try:
        for line in Path("/proc/meminfo").read_text().splitlines():
            if line.startswith("MemAvailable:"):
                gib = int(line.split()[1]) / (1024 * 1024)
                break
        else:
            return cpus
    except OSError:
        return cpus
    return max(1, min(cpus, int(gib / (3.0 * n_arch))))


def _version() -> str:
    local = os.environ.get("FAST_ULYSSES_LOCAL_VERSION", "")
    return f"{_base_version()}+{local}" if local else _base_version()


def _requires() -> list[str]:
    """The runtime pin, derived from the torch this was built against.

    torch is the only runtime dependency, and the pin is exact to its MINOR: the .so embeds
    c10d::Work vtables, c10::intrusive_ptr in its op schemas, a pybind11 module and a
    TORCH_LIBRARY registration, and none of those survive a minor bump.

    Reading it needs the torch this will link against, so the build cannot run under pip's
    build isolation -- and torch cannot be declared a build requirement either, because pip
    would then install its own copy into the isolated environment and the extension would link
    that one instead of the user's. Turn the bare ModuleNotFoundError into the instruction.
    """
    try:
        import torch
    except ImportError:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "fast-ulysses builds against the torch already installed in the target environment, "
            "so it cannot be built under pip's build isolation.\n"
            "    pip install torch                      # the version you intend to run\n"
            "    pip install fast-ulysses --no-build-isolation\n"
            "Prebuilt wheels avoid the source build entirely: see docs/install.md."
        ) from None

    major, minor = torch.__version__.split(".")[:2]
    return [f"torch=={major}.{minor}.*"]


class CMakeExtension(Extension):
    def __init__(self, name: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(name, sources=[])


class CMakeBuild(build_ext):
    def build_extension(self, ext: Extension) -> None:

# u1-l4 仓库结构与阅读地图

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说出 `include/`、`src/`、`python/`、`test/`、`benchmark/`、`tools/`、`docs/` 每个目录的职责，以及每个目录下代表性文件的作用。
2. 解释 `src/a2a_plan.cc` 为什么刻意保持「无 CUDA、无 torch、无通信库」，以及这一分层决策带来的两个直接好处（无 GPU 可测布局、Meta 内核复用同一份形状规则）。
3. 建立从 `group.all_to_all_4d(x)` 出发，经 `src/bindings.cc`、`src/group.cc`、`src/a2a_plan.cc`，到达 `src/transfer.cu` / `src/barrier.cu` 的完整调用链骨架，并在每个节点标注文件与函数名。
4. 知道开发工具链的入口在哪：pre-commit（ruff + clang-format）、pytest 分层标记、setup.py → CMake → nvcc 的构建链条、`tools/` 下的发布三件套。

本讲是「地图课」：不深入任何一层的机制细节（那是 u3–u9 的事），但要让你之后阅读任何一篇讲义时，都知道代码在仓库的哪个角落、沿着哪条链走。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲需要的前置概念在前三讲已经建立，这里只做一句话回顾，另补两个新术语：

- **torch 自定义算子扩展**：本仓库的 C++/CUDA 代码最终编译成一个名为 `_C` 的共享库（`.so`），Python 侧 `import fast_ulysses` 时通过 `from . import _C` 触发加载，算子在加载时注册进 torch 的 dispatcher（u1-l1、u1-l3）。
- **mode 0 / mode 1**：Ulysses 两次 all-to-all 的方向——mode 0 用序列分片换头分片，mode 1 是其逆（u1-l2）。
- **翻译单元（Translation Unit, TU）**：C++ 里一个 `.cc` / `.cu` 源文件加上它包含的头文件，经编译器单独编译成一个目标文件。说「a2a_plan.cc 这个 TU 无 CUDA、无 torch」，指的是它 `#include` 的所有头里都没有 torch 或 CUDA 的东西——因此它可以在任何有 C++ 编译器的环境里编译和测试。
- **torchbind 自定义类**：通过 `TORCH_LIBRARY` 的 `m.class_<...>()` 注册、可以在 Python 里以 `torch.classes.命名空间.类名` 形式持有的 C++ 对象。本项目的 `UlyssesGroup`（C++ 侧的有状态对象）就是这样暴露给 Python 的。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 在本讲中的角色 |
|---|---|
| [docs/develop.md](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/develop.md) | 官方开发文档：目录树、lint、测试分层、发布流程 |
| [CMakeLists.txt](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/CMakeLists.txt) | 把 `src/*.cc` + `src/*.cu` 编译成 `_C` 扩展的 CMake 脚本 |
| [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/pyproject.toml) | 包元数据：包目录在 `python/` 下、CLI 入口、pytest 标记、ruff 配置 |
| [setup.py](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/setup.py) | setuptools 入口：调用 cmake 完成 `_C` 的编译 |
| [src/a2a_plan.cc](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc) | 纯主机寻址层：把 4D all-to-all 翻译成一组带步长的字节拷贝 |
| [include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp) | `A2ADims` / `CopyOp` / `A2APlan` 三个数据结构的定义与契约 |
| [python/fast_ulysses/group.py](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py) | Python API 门面：构造、两个集合调用、输出分配器 |
| [src/bindings.cc](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc) | torch 算子层：校验、autograd、Meta 内核、op 注册 |
| [src/group.cc](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc) | 有状态层：对称内存窗口、plan 缓存、暂存池 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 目录职责：一张仓库地图

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

fast-ulysses 是一个「小而深」的仓库：不含文档与测试，核心代码只有约 10 个 C++/CUDA 文件加一个 Python 门面。目录划分遵循一条清晰的分层原则——**谁依赖 torch，谁依赖 CUDA，谁两者都不依赖**：

- `python/` 只做薄封装，几乎所有跨调用存活的状态（对称内存窗口、plan 缓存、暂存缓冲）都在 C++ 侧的 `UlyssesGroup` 对象里；
- `src/` 里再分三层：torch 算子层（`bindings.cc`）、有状态层（`group.cc`）、纯算术层（`a2a_plan.cc`）与设备层（`transfer.cu`、`barrier.cu`）；
- `include/fast_ulysses/` 是各层对外的契约（带 Doxygen 注释），同层或下层实现 `.cc` 与之对应。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一次阅读仓库时，目录间的依赖方向是：

```
python/fast_ulysses/            group.py、cli.py、_diagnose.py（API 门面 + 工具）
        │  torch.ops / torch.classes
        ▼
src/bindings.cc                 torch 算子层：校验 → 屏障 → 传输 → 屏障 → copy_out
src/plan_bindings.cc            （旁路）纯主机 plan 的调试出口
        │
        ▼
src/group.cc                    有状态层：窗口分配、plan 缓存、staging 池
        │                                │
        ▼                                ▼
src/a2a_plan.cc                src/transfer.cu + src/barrier.cu
（纯主机寻址，无 CUDA 无 torch）  （设备侧，不知道 peer 地址从哪来）
```

支撑目录不参与这条链：`test/`（四层测试）、`benchmark/`（基准）、`tools/`（构建与发布脚本）、`docs/`（文档）、`examples/`（示例）。

### 4.2 无 CUDA、无 torch 的 plan 层

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

整个仓库最核心的分层决策是：**把「4D all-to-all 应该搬哪些字节」这件纯算术的事，单独放进 `src/a2a_plan.cc`，并且让它不依赖 CUDA、不依赖 torch、不依赖任何通信库**。

为什么值得这么做？回忆 u1-l1 的第二条特性「重排即步长」：本库不做 `permute` 重排内核，而是把序列/头的排列直接编码成每次拷贝的源/目的步长。于是「一次交换搬运得对不对」完全等价于「plan 里这组 `CopyOp` 算得对不对」——而这是一道纯整数算术题，不需要 GPU 也能验证。把这一层隔离干净，等于把**正确性里最大的一块**从「需要 8 张卡」降级成「需要一台能跑 Python + numpy 的机器」。

这一决策带来两个直接收益：

1. **无 GPU 的布局测试**：`test/test_plan.py` 用 numpy 字节缓冲逐条重放 `CopyOp`，与 `all_to_all_single + permute` 的参照做位精确对照——CI 没有 GPU 也能跑（[docs/develop.md:L50-L52](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/develop.md#L50-L52)），u3-l3 精读。
2. **Meta 内核零重复**：torch 的 FakeTensor/导出路径需要纯形状传播。本库的 Meta 内核直接调用 `group->plan()` 拿输出形状，而不是在 Python 里重写一遍不均匀分片的形状规则——[src/bindings.cc:L276-L280](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L276-L280) 的注释明说：在 Python 重写会让「test_plan.py 够不到的第二份副本」出现，**这正是 a2a_plan.cc 作为一个无 torch、无 CUDA 翻译单元存在的全部理由**。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

plan 层的输入输出可以画成：

```
输入                          纯主机计算                       输出
A2ADims                       build_plan(dims, mode,           A2APlan
  b, d                          elem_size)                       output_shape   ← 本 rank 收到的形状
  rank, world_size                                                window_numel   ← 所有 rank 中最大的接收量
  seq_splits[ws]                                                  ops[]          ← 本 rank 发出的拷贝列表
  head_splits[ws]                                                   每个 CopyOp: peer, src/dst_offset,
                                                                        src/dst_pitch, width,
                                                                        rows, depth, src/dst_slice
```

`CopyOp` 的字段设计刻意做到「同一结构既描述一次 `cudaMemcpy2D/3DAsync`，也描述一次测试里的主机重放」——偏移都以字节计、相对各自缓冲的基址（[include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp:L36-L51](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp#L36-L51)）。这就是「寻址的纯主机表达」：设备层只管发射，不算偏移。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**证据一：include 列表干净。** [src/a2a_plan.cc:L1-L6](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L1-L6) 只包含自己的头与四个标准库头；而 [include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp:L7-L8](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp#L7-L8) 只有 `<cstdint>` 和 `<vector>`。整条 include 链上没有 torch、没有 CUDA。

**证据二：头文件的自我声明。** [include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp:L2-L6](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp#L2-L6) 开头注释写明设计意图：寻址用 pitched copy 表达、纯主机算术、无 CUDA 无 torch 无通信库，因此布局契约可以独立测试；并声明**不均匀分片是一般情况，偶均分只是特例**（`seq_splits = [s/P]*P`），所以只有一条代码路径需要写对。

**证据三：build_plan 的主体。** [src/a2a_plan.cc:L143-L216](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L143-L216)：先 `validate()`，再算 `seq_total` / `head_total` 与两组前缀和，然后对每个 peer 发射一个 `CopyOp`——mode 0 分支「读跨步、写连续」，mode 1 分支「读连续、写跨步」。具体每条拷贝的推导是 u3-l2 的主题，本讲只需要认识到：**这里没有任何一行涉及设备、句柄或 torch 张量**。

**证据四：相遇点被隔离在一个独立 TU。** [src/plan_bindings.cc:L1-L4](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/plan_bindings.cc#L1-L4) 的注释点破：`a2a_plan.cc` 自己保持无 torch 无 CUDA，**这个文件是两者相遇的唯一地点**。它把 `build_plan` 包成调试算子 `a2a_plan_debug`，返回 `(output_shape, window_numel, ops 张量)`，注册在 [src/plan_bindings.cc:L57-L62](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/plan_bindings.cc#L57-L62)。

**实践目标**：亲眼确认 plan 层的「纯净」，并用调试算子看到一份真实的 plan。

**操作步骤**：

2. 若你已在 u1-l3 完成构建，运行以下脚本（不需要 GPU、不需要进程组；若尚未构建，标注「待本地验证」并只做纸面推演）：

```python

from fast_ulysses import _C  # 触发算子注册

shape, window_numel, ops = torch.ops.fast_ulysses.a2a_plan_debug(
    b=1, d=64, rank=0, world_size=4,

**需要观察的现象**：`seq_splits` 里有一个 0（rank 2 没有序列），`ops` 里却不会出现 `peer == 2` 的行——零长度分片直接不发射拷贝；`window_numel` 等于所有 rank 中最大接收量（这里是 rank 3 收 `b × 15 × 10 × 64` 个元素——全部序列拼起来 × rank 3 的头数）。请按 [src/a2a_plan.cc:L166-L173](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L166-L173) 的循环手算一遍再比对。

**练习 1**：如果不小心在 `a2a_plan.cc` 里加了一行 `#include <torch/extension.h>`（比如为了用 `TORCH_CHECK` 做校验），会立刻坏掉什么？不会坏掉什么？

<details><summary>参考答案</summary>

见 [src/plan_bindings.cc:L2-L4](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/plan_bindings.cc#L2-L4)：`bindings.cc` 的 schema 引用了自定义类（`__torch__.torch.classes.fast_ulysses.UlyssesGroup`），跨 TU 的静态初始化顺序会影响类定义是否先于引用它的 schema 就绪；而 `a2a_plan_debug` 的 schema 不含自定义类，所以没有顺序问题。这是一条 C++ 静态初始化顺序的实战教训。
</details>

**练习 3**：Meta 内核复用 `group->plan()` 而不在 Python 重写形状规则，除了「避免第二份副本」，还有一个更直接的安全理由，是什么？

<details><summary>参考答案</summary>

plan() 是纯主机代码、不在设备上分配任何东西（[src/bindings.cc:L277-L279](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L277-L279) 的注释），所以在 FakeTensor/Meta 这种「没有真设备」的路径里调用它是安全的；同时它在路上把形状、dtype、splits 的全部检查又跑了一遍。
</details>

### 4.3 调用链骨架：从 Python 到 CUDA 拷贝

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

现在把各层串起来。一次最普通的调用 `y = group.all_to_all_4d(x)`（sync 路径、`mode=0`、无 `out=`、无 splits）在仓库里要穿过 6 个文件。理解这条链是本讲的核心交付：之后 u4–u7 的每一讲，都是把链上某个节点放大。

调用链的五个阶段（bindings.cc 文件头注释 [src/bindings.cc:L1-L2](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L1-L2) 的一句话总结）：**校验张量 → 从组里取 plan 和窗口 → 屏障 → 传输 → 屏障 → copy out**。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```
y = group.all_to_all_4d(x, mode=0)                                  ← 用户代码
│
① python/fast_ulysses/group.py :: UlyssesGroup.all_to_all_4d
│    无 out= 分支直接转发：
│    torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d(self._handle, x, mode, seq, head)
│    （_handle 是 C++ UlyssesGroup 的 torchbind 对象）
│        │  进入 torch dispatcher（Autograd key → 计算内核）
│        ▼
② src/bindings.cc :: all_to_all_4d_autograd → all_to_all_4d
│    require_cuda + CUDAGuard 后调 run(...)
│        ▼
③ src/bindings.cc :: run
│    ├─ prepare(...)                     ← 全部校验 + 取 plan/窗口（必须先于第一个屏障）
│    │    ├─ group->check_alive() / group->prune_owned()          [src/group.cc]
│    │    ├─ require_cuda / require_group_device
│    │    ├─ group->plan(sizes, mode, dtype, seq, head)           [src/group.cc]
│    │    │    ├─ make_dims(...)                                  [src/group.cc] 形状与 splits 交叉校验
│    │    │    └─ ulysses::build_plan(dims, mode, elem_size)      [src/a2a_plan.cc] ← 纯主机寻址
│    │    ├─ 输出三态：caller 的 out / at::empty 新分配
│    │    └─ group->window(kSyncWindow, dtype, window_numel)      [src/group.cc]
│    │         （首次或需增长时 → allocate()：对称内存分配 + rendezvous）
│    ├─ transfer_on_stream(...)
│    │    ├─ fast_barrier(stream, win->flag_ptrs, rank)           [src/barrier.cu]  开局屏障
│    │    ├─ launch_a2a_ce(x.data_ptr(), win->peer_ptrs, plan,    [src/transfer.cu]
│    │    │                  xfer_stream, rank, stream)
│    │    │    └─ 对 plan.ops 每个 CopyOp: issue_copy(...)       [src/transfer.cu]
│    │    │         → cudaMemcpy2DAsync / cudaMemcpy3DAsync
│    │    └─ fast_barrier(...)                                    [src/barrier.cu]  收尾屏障
│    └─ copy_out(call, stream, rank)      [src/bindings.cc]      copying 路径才有：
│         窗口 → 输出张量的一次平坦 D2D 拷贝
│        ▼
④ 返回 y（zero-copy 路径下 y 就是窗口本身，copy_out 被跳过）
```

三条贯穿性的设计约束（后面各讲反复引用）：

1. **校验全部先于第一个屏障**：被拒绝的参数不能让本 rank 停在屏障上等一个根本不会来的对端（[src/bindings.cc:L87-L88](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L87-L88)）。
2. **设备层不算偏移、不知道地址从哪来**：`launch_a2a_ce` 的偏移全部来自 `plan.ops`，peer 地址由调用者传入——这正是 transfer.hpp 头注释 [include/fast_ulysses/transfer.hpp:L1-L5](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/transfer.hpp#L1-L5) 说的「以此把所有通信库挡在这个翻译单元之外」。
3. **状态都在 C++ 组对象里**：plan 缓存（`std::map<PlanKey, A2APlan>`）、窗口表、暂存池都是 `UlyssesGroup` 的成员，Python 侧每次调用只是无状态转发。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**第①跳：Python 转发。** [python/fast_ulysses/group.py:L111-L132](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L111-L132) 定义 `all_to_all_4d`；无 `out=` 时它只有一行实质调用——把 `_handle`（构造时经 [python/fast_ulysses/group.py:L87-L89](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L87-L89) 创建的 `torch.classes.fast_ulysses.UlyssesGroup`）连同张量与参数交给注册算子。

**第②跳：算子注册与 autograd 入口。** 算子 schema 注册在 [src/bindings.cc:L718-L726](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L718-L726)：`all_to_all_4d` 注册了 `CompositeExplicitAutograd`（计算）、`Autograd`（[src/bindings.cc:L584-L605](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L584-L605)，处理反向与前向 AD）和 `Meta` 三个 key。无梯度需求时 autograd 入口直接走 [src/bindings.cc:L253-L270](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L253-L270) 的 `all_to_all_4d`，它取当前 CUDA 流后调 `run`。

**第③跳 run 的三段式。** [src/bindings.cc:L225-L241](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L225-L241)：`run = prepare + transfer_on_stream + (可选) copy_out`。

- `prepare`（[src/bindings.cc:L89-L174](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L89-L174)）：校验链 + 从组里取 plan 与窗口，并把「输入/输出与窗口的字节区间是否重叠」也查掉。
- `transfer_on_stream`（[src/bindings.cc:L194-L211](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L194-L211)）：开局屏障（写者等读者）→ `launch_a2a_ce` → 收尾屏障。
- `copy_out`（[src/bindings.cc:L216-L223](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L216-L223)）：一次 `cudaMemcpyAsync`（D2D），把窗口内容搬到调用者持有的输出张量。

**第③跳内：plan 的来路。** [src/group.cc:L167-L196](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L167-L196) 的 `UlyssesGroup::plan` 以 `(sizes, seq, head, mode, dtype)` 为缓存键，未命中时先经 [src/group.cc:L45-L136](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L45-L136) 的 `make_dims`（形状 4D、dtype 白名单、16 字节对齐、splits 交叉校验、偶均分特例），再调 `build_plan`（[src/group.cc:L191-L195](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L191-L195)）——从这里进入 4.2 的纯主机层。

**第③跳内：窗口的来路。** [src/group.cc:L255-L267](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L255-L267) 的 `window` 按 `(role, dtype)` 查缓存，尺寸不够则「先删旧再分配」，最终落到 [src/group.cc:L207-L253](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L207-L253) 的 `allocate`：torch 对称内存分配 + rendezvous 收集每个 peer 的地址 + 清零握手区（u4-l1 的主题）。

**第③跳底：两次设备调用。** 传输与屏障是一对：

- [src/transfer.cu:L68-L126](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/transfer.cu#L68-L126) `launch_a2a_ce`：peer 按 `rank ^ k` 异或序枚举（非 2 幂 world_size 再补一次扫描），远端拷贝串行发在 `xfer` 专用流上，本 rank 自份额发在调用者流上，最后用事件把两流汇合。每个 `CopyOp` 经 [src/transfer.cu:L26-L52](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/transfer.cu#L26-L52) 的 `issue_copy` 变成一次 `cudaMemcpy2DAsync`（`depth<=1`）或 `cudaMemcpy3DAsync`（batch 折叠）。
- [src/barrier.cu:L53-L67](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/barrier.cu#L53-L67) `fast_barrier`：`world_size==1` 直接返回（u1-l3 见过的「ws=1 跳过屏障」就在这行）；否则发射 [src/barrier.cu:L31-L49](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/barrier.cu#L31-L49) 的单块自旋内核 `barrier_kernel`，用内联 PTX 的 release/acquire 指令发布与等待 epoch（u5-l3 逐行精读）。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：亲手把 4.3.2 的骨架补成一张「每个节点带文件 + 函数名 + 行号」的调用链卡片，并用两个无 GPU 手段交叉验证其中两跳。

**操作步骤**：

1. 从 [python/fast_ulysses/group.py:L129-L132](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L129-L132) 出发，用编辑器的「跳转到定义」或 Grep 依次追每一跳，把 4.3.2 的图抄录成自己的版本，并在每个节点补上行号。
2. 验证「plan 跳」：运行 4.2.4 的 `a2a_plan_debug` 脚本，确认它输出的 `ops` 与主链上 `group->plan()` 缓存的是同一份计算（同一个 `build_plan`）。
3. 验证「ws=1 跳过屏障」：读 [src/barrier.cu:L55-L57](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/barrier.cu#L55-L57)，确认 `ws == 1` 时 `fast_barrier` 直接 return——这解释了 u1-l3 里「world_size=1 时哪些行为仍然成立」的观察。
4. 在图中用两种颜色（或标记）区分**每次调用都要走的节点**（prepare、两个屏障、launch_a2a_ce）与**只有首次/增长时才走的节点**（`make_dims`+`build_plan` 未命中、`allocate`）。

**需要观察的现象**：plan 命中缓存时 `make_dims` / `build_plan` 完全不执行；窗口已存在且够大时 `allocate` 不执行。即稳态调用只剩「校验 + 两次屏障 + 拷贝发射 + copy_out」。

**预期结果**：一张你自己画的、带文件/函数/行号标注的调用链文本图（综合实践会把它变成正式产出）。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：链上哪一步是「集体操作」（所有 rank 必须同时到达）？哪一步不是？

<details><summary>参考答案</summary>

两个 `fast_barrier` 之间夹着的传输是集体的：屏障本身要求全组到达，所以 `launch_a2a_ce` 实际上被开局/收尾屏障变成了集合点。`plan` / `build_plan` 是纯本地计算（但输入 splits 全 rank 一致，所以结果一致）；`allocate` 是集合性的（rendezvous）；`copy_out` 是纯本地拷贝。校验必须先于第一个屏障，否则会挂起而非报错（u2-l2 的契约）。
</details>

**练习 2**：`prepare` 里为什么要同时检查「输入与窗口重叠」和「输出与窗口重叠」两种情况，而 `out=` 来自 `empty_output()` 时又豁免？

<details><summary>参考答案</summary>

见 [src/bindings.cc:L158-L172](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L158-L172)：输入或输出若与窗口共享字节，会在「每个 peer 都在写窗口」时被同时读/写。`out` **本身是**窗口（zero-copy 路径）是唯一合法的重叠，在 [src/bindings.cc:L134-L138](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L134-L138) 被 `out_is_window` 标记后跳过检查。
</details>

**练习 3**：本 rank 自己的那份数据走窗口吗？证据在哪一行？

<details><summary>参考答案</summary>

走。`launch_a2a_ce` 里 `emit(rank, stream)` 把自份额也发射到调用者流上（[src/transfer.cu:L116](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/transfer.cu#L116)）；plan 侧的依据是 [include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp:L62-L64](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp#L62-L64)——`ops` 覆盖全部 `world_size` 个目的地，包括自己，这让 zero-copy 与 copy-out 都成为可能（u3-l2 详解）。
</details>

### 4.4 开发工具链

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

一张地图还要标出「营地设施」：改代码前后你会用什么、跑什么。本仓库的工具链刻意做得入口极少：

- **唯一 lint 入口**是 pre-commit：Python 用 ruff（行宽 100、py310+），C++/CUDA 用 clang-format 并**钉死 v15.0.7**——版本漂移会重排整棵树（[docs/develop.md:L32-L40](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/develop.md#L32-L40)）。
- **唯一测试入口**是 pytest，用 `multigpu` 标记把「需要 ≥2 卡的 torchrun worker」与「host-only 测试」分开。
- **唯一构建入口**是 `pip install -e .` → `setup.py` → `cmake` → `nvcc`，持久化 `build/` 目录让增量编译只重编改动的翻译单元（[docs/develop.md:L10-L11](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/develop.md#L10-L11)）。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

构建链条与各文件的分工：

```
pip install -e . --no-build-isolation
  └─ setup.py :: CMakeBuild.build_extension      [setup.py:L91-L136]
       ├─ 读 FAST_ULYSSES_CUDA_ARCH → 设 TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST
       ├─ cmake -S . -B build（configure）
       │    └─ CMakeLists.txt：找 torch、探测 c10d::register_work、
       │       GLOB src/*.cc + src/*.cu → add_library(_C SHARED ...)   [CMakeLists.txt:L126-L129]
       ├─ cmake --build build -jN（受内存预算约束的并行度）            [setup.py:L31-L51]
       └─ 把构建事实写成 fast_ulysses/_build_meta.py                   [setup.py:L149-L171]
```

测试入口的分层（[docs/develop.md:L44-L48](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/develop.md#L44-L48)）：

| 命令 | 前提 | 覆盖 |
|---|---|---|
| `pytest -m "not multigpu"` | 只需已构建的 `_C`，无需 GPU、无需进程组 | `test_plan.py`（布局重放）+ `test_wheel_matrix.py` |
| `pytest -m multigpu` | ≥2 GPU | `test_distributed.py` 拉起 `distributed/` 下 8 个 worker |
| 直接 `torchrun --nproc_per_node=N test/distributed/<worker>.py` | 同上 | 调试单个 worker 的最短路径 |

发布三件套（本讲只记位置，u8 详解）：`tools/build_wheels.sh`（一条 (torch, CUDA) 行出一个 wheel）、`tools/check_wheel.py`（ELF/元数据门禁）、`tools/preflight_gpu.sh`（打 tag 前必须在真多卡机上跑）；基准必须包在 `tools/exclusive.sh` 里，它打印 `EXCLUSIVE` 或 `CONTENDED`——「CONTENDED 的数字不是数字」（[docs/develop.md:L99-L100](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/develop.md#L99-L100)）。

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

- [pyproject.toml:L36-L41](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/pyproject.toml#L36-L41)：pytest 的 `testpaths = ["test"]` 与 `multigpu` 标记定义——上一节的两个命令就来自这里。
- [.pre-commit-config.yaml:L17-L23](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/.pre-commit-config.yaml#L17-L23)：clang-format 钉在 `v15.0.7`，且 `files: ^(include|src)/` 只管 C++/CUDA。
- [setup.py:L59-L83](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/setup.py#L59-L83)：`_requires()` 解释了 u1-l3 遇到的两件事——torch 是唯一运行时依赖且**精确钉到 minor**（`.so` 里嵌着 c10d 的 vtable 与 pybind11 模块，minor 一升就 ABI 断裂）；以及为什么构建不能在 pip 的 build isolation 里跑（隔离环境会装另一份 torch，扩展就链错对象）。
- [CMakeLists.txt:L126-L129](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/CMakeLists.txt#L126-L129)：源文件收集方式——`file(GLOB ...)` 全量收进一个 `_C` 目标，这也是 4.1.4 实践的证据。
- [setup.py:L149-L171](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/setup.py#L149-L171)：`_write_build_meta` 把版本、torch ABI、CUDA 版本、arch 列表、`HAS_WORK_REGISTRY` 写成 Python 模块——u1-l3 里 `doctor` 打印的构建信息、u8-l3 里 `_diagnose` 的归因都读它。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：跑通本机可行的工具链入口，确认「哪些检查不需要 GPU」。

**操作步骤**：

1. 读 [docs/develop.md:L30-L48](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/develop.md#L30-L48)，列出三条你会用到的命令。
2. 若已按 u1-l3 构建：运行 `pytest -m "not multigpu"`，记录通过/跳过的用例数；再运行 `pre-commit run --all-files`（需先 `pip install -e ".[dev]"` 与 `pre-commit install`）。

**需要观察的现象**：host-only 测试不需要 `torchrun`、不需要初始化进程组，几秒内跑完；`multigpu` 用例在少卡环境显示 skipped 而非 failed。

<details><summary>参考答案</summary>

</details>

<details><summary>参考答案</summary>

<details><summary>参考答案</summary>

## 5. 综合实践

把本讲全部内容串成一个产出物：**一张带完整标注的调用链地图**。

## 6. 本讲小结

- 仓库按「依赖 torch 与否、依赖 CUDA 与否」分层：`python/` 是薄门面，`src/bindings.cc` 是 torch 算子层，`src/group.cc` 是有状态层，`src/a2a_plan.cc` 是纯主机寻址层，`src/transfer.cu` + `src/barrier.cu` 是设备层；`test/`、`benchmark/`、`tools/`、`docs/` 在链外支撑。
- `src/a2a_plan.cc` 刻意无 CUDA、无 torch、无通信库，换来两个收益：布局正确性可以无 GPU 测试（`test_plan.py` 的 numpy 重放），以及 Meta 内核直接复用 `plan()` 而不产生第二份形状规则；torch 与 plan 的唯一相遇点被隔离在 `src/plan_bindings.cc`。
- 一次 sync 调用的骨架是 `prepare → 屏障 → 传输 → 屏障 → copy_out`：校验全部先于第一个屏障，plan 与窗口按 `(shape, mode, dtype, splits)` / `(role, dtype)` 缓存，稳态调用只剩校验、两次屏障、拷贝发射与 copy_out。
- 设备层不算偏移、不知道地址来源：`launch_a2a_ce` 只消费 `CopyOp` 与传入的 peer 地址，`fast_barrier` 只消费 flag 地址；`ws == 1` 时屏障整体跳过。
- 工具链入口极少：pre-commit（ruff + 钉版 clang-format）管 lint，pytest 用 `multigpu` 标记分两层，构建走 `setup.py` → CMake → nvcc 且必须 `--no-build-isolation`；CI 无 GPU，只证明编译/链接/加载/host-only 布局。

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说出 `include/`、`src/`、`python/`、`test/`、`benchmark/`、`tools/`、`docs/` 每个目录的职责，以及每个目录下代表性文件的作用。
2. 解释 `src/a2a_plan.cc` 为什么刻意保持「无 CUDA、无 torch、无通信库」，以及这一分层决策带来的两个直接好处（无 GPU 可测布局、Meta 内核复用同一份形状规则）。
3. 建立从 `group.all_to_all_4d(x)` 出发，经 `src/bindings.cc`、`src/group.cc`、`src/a2a_plan.cc`，到达 `src/transfer.cu` / `src/barrier.cu` 的完整调用链骨架，并在每个节点标注文件与函数名。
4. 知道开发工具链的入口在哪：pre-commit（ruff + clang-format）、pytest 分层标记、setup.py → CMake → nvcc 的构建链条、`tools/` 下的发布三件套。

本讲是「地图课」：不深入任何一层的机制细节（那是 u3–u9 的事），但要让你之后阅读任何一篇讲义时，都知道代码在仓库的哪个角落、沿着哪条链走。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲需要的前置概念在前三讲已经建立，这里只做一句话回顾，另补两个新术语：

- **torch 自定义算子扩展**：本仓库的 C++/CUDA 代码最终编译成一个名为 `_C` 的共享库（`.so`），Python 侧 `import fast_ulysses` 时通过 `from . import _C` 触发加载，算子在加载时注册进 torch 的 dispatcher（u1-l1、u1-l3）。
- **mode 0 / mode 1**：Ulysses 两次 all-to-all 的方向——mode 0 用序列分片换头分片，mode 1 是其逆（u1-l2）。
- **翻译单元（Translation Unit, TU）**：C++ 里一个 `.cc` / `.cu` 源文件加上它包含的头文件，经编译器单独编译成一个目标文件。说「a2a_plan.cc 这个 TU 无 CUDA、无 torch」，指的是它 `#include` 的所有头里都没有 torch 或 CUDA 的东西——因此它可以在任何有 C++ 编译器的环境里编译和测试。
- **torchbind 自定义类**：通过 `TORCH_LIBRARY` 的 `m.class_<...>()` 注册、可以在 Python 里以 `torch.classes.命名空间.类名` 形式持有的 C++ 对象。本项目的 `UlyssesGroup`（C++ 侧的有状态对象）就是这样暴露给 Python 的。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 目录职责：一张仓库地图

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

fast-ulysses 是一个「小而深」的仓库：不含文档与测试，核心代码只有约 10 个 C++/CUDA 文件加一个 Python 门面。目录划分遵循一条清晰的分层原则——**谁依赖 torch，谁依赖 CUDA，谁两者都不依赖**：

- `python/` 只做薄封装，几乎所有跨调用存活的状态（对称内存窗口、plan 缓存、暂存缓冲）都在 C++ 侧的 `UlyssesGroup` 对象里；
- `src/` 里再分三层：torch 算子层（`bindings.cc`）、有状态层（`group.cc`）、纯算术层（`a2a_plan.cc`）与设备层（`transfer.cu`、`barrier.cu`）；
- `include/fast_ulysses/` 是各层对外的契约（带 Doxygen 注释），同层或下层实现 `.cc` 与之对应。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一次阅读仓库时，目录间的依赖方向是：

```
python/fast_ulysses/            group.py、cli.py、_diagnose.py（API 门面 + 工具）
        │  torch.ops / torch.classes
        ▼
src/bindings.cc                 torch 算子层：校验 → 屏障 → 传输 → 屏障 → copy_out
src/plan_bindings.cc            （旁路）纯主机 plan 的调试出口
        │
        ▼
src/group.cc                    有状态层：窗口分配、plan 缓存、staging 池
        │                                │
        ▼                                ▼
src/a2a_plan.cc                src/transfer.cu + src/barrier.cu
（纯主机寻址，无 CUDA 无 torch）  （设备侧，不知道 peer 地址从哪来）
```

支撑目录不参与这条链：`test/`（四层测试）、`benchmark/`（基准）、`tools/`（构建与发布脚本）、`docs/`（文档）、`examples/`（示例）。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

官方文档 [docs/develop.md:L13-L28](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/develop.md#L13-L28) 给出了目录树，并特别强调了一条分层纪律：**`src/a2a_plan.cc` 不含 CUDA、不含 torch、不含通信库，请保持这样——这正是布局契约可以脱离 GPU 测试的原因**（4.2 节详解）。

### 4.2 无 CUDA、无 torch 的 plan 层

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

整个仓库最核心的分层决策是：**把「4D all-to-all 应该搬哪些字节」这件纯算术的事，单独放进 `src/a2a_plan.cc`，并且让它不依赖 CUDA、不依赖 torch、不依赖任何通信库**。

为什么值得这么做？回忆 u1-l1 的第二条特性「重排即步长」：本库不做 `permute` 重排内核，而是把序列/头的排列直接编码成每次拷贝的源/目的步长。于是「一次交换搬运得对不对」完全等价于「plan 里这组 `CopyOp` 算得对不对」——而这是一道纯整数算术题，不需要 GPU 也能验证。把这一层隔离干净，等于把**正确性里最大的一块**从「需要 8 张卡」降级成「需要一台能跑 Python + numpy 的机器」。

这一决策带来两个直接收益：

1. **无 GPU 的布局测试**：`test/test_plan.py` 用 numpy 字节缓冲逐条重放 `CopyOp`，与 `all_to_all_single + permute` 的参照做位精确对照——CI 没有 GPU 也能跑（[docs/develop.md:L50-L52](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/develop.md#L50-L52)），u3-l3 精读。
2. **Meta 内核零重复**：torch 的 FakeTensor/导出路径需要纯形状传播。本库的 Meta 内核直接调用 `group->plan()` 拿输出形状，而不是在 Python 里重写一遍不均匀分片的形状规则——[src/bindings.cc:L276-L280](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L276-L280) 的注释明说：在 Python 重写会让「test_plan.py 够不到的第二份副本」出现，**这正是 a2a_plan.cc 作为一个无 torch、无 CUDA 翻译单元存在的全部理由**。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

plan 层的输入输出可以画成：

```
输入                          纯主机计算                       输出
A2ADims                       build_plan(dims, mode,           A2APlan
  b, d                          elem_size)                       output_shape   ← 本 rank 收到的形状
  rank, world_size                                                window_numel   ← 所有 rank 中最大的接收量
  seq_splits[ws]                                                  ops[]          ← 本 rank 发出的拷贝列表
  head_splits[ws]                                                   每个 CopyOp: peer, src/dst_offset,
                                                                        src/dst_pitch, width,
                                                                        rows, depth, src/dst_slice
```

`CopyOp` 的字段设计刻意做到「同一结构既描述一次 `cudaMemcpy2D/3DAsync`，也描述一次测试里的主机重放」——偏移都以字节计、相对各自缓冲的基址（[include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp:L36-L51](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp#L36-L51)）。这就是「寻址的纯主机表达」：设备层只管发射，不算偏移。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**证据一：include 列表干净。** [src/a2a_plan.cc:L1-L6](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L1-L6) 只包含自己的头与四个标准库头；而 [include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp:L7-L8](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp#L7-L8) 只有 `<cstdint>` 和 `<vector>`。整条 include 链上没有 torch、没有 CUDA。

**证据二：头文件的自我声明。** [include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp:L2-L6](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp#L2-L6) 开头注释写明设计意图：寻址用 pitched copy 表达、纯主机算术、无 CUDA 无 torch 无通信库，因此布局契约可以独立测试；并声明**不均匀分片是一般情况，偶均分只是特例**（`seq_splits = [s/P]*P`），所以只有一条代码路径需要写对。

**证据三：build_plan 的主体。** [src/a2a_plan.cc:L143-L216](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L143-L216)：先 `validate()`，再算 `seq_total` / `head_total` 与两组前缀和，然后对每个 peer 发射一个 `CopyOp`——mode 0 分支「读跨步、写连续」，mode 1 分支「读连续、写跨步」。具体每条拷贝的推导是 u3-l2 的主题，本讲只需要认识到：**这里没有任何一行涉及设备、句柄或 torch 张量**。

**证据四：相遇点被隔离在一个独立 TU。** [src/plan_bindings.cc:L1-L4](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/plan_bindings.cc#L1-L4) 的注释点破：`a2a_plan.cc` 自己保持无 torch 无 CUDA，**这个文件是两者相遇的唯一地点**。它把 `build_plan` 包成调试算子 `a2a_plan_debug`，返回 `(output_shape, window_numel, ops 张量)`，注册在 [src/plan_bindings.cc:L57-L62](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/plan_bindings.cc#L57-L62)。

### 4.3 调用链骨架：从 Python 到 CUDA 拷贝

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

现在把各层串起来。一次最普通的调用 `y = group.all_to_all_4d(x)`（sync 路径、`mode=0`、无 `out=`、无 splits）在仓库里要穿过 6 个文件。理解这条链是本讲的核心交付：之后 u4–u7 的每一讲，都是把链上某个节点放大。

调用链的五个阶段（bindings.cc 文件头注释 [src/bindings.cc:L1-L2](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L1-L2) 的一句话总结）：**校验张量 → 从组里取 plan 和窗口 → 屏障 → 传输 → 屏障 → copy out**。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```
y = group.all_to_all_4d(x, mode=0)                                  ← 用户代码
│
① python/fast_ulysses/group.py :: UlyssesGroup.all_to_all_4d
│    无 out= 分支直接转发：
│    torch.ops.fast_ulysses.all_to_all_4d(self._handle, x, mode, seq, head)
│    （_handle 是 C++ UlyssesGroup 的 torchbind 对象）
│        │  进入 torch dispatcher（Autograd key → 计算内核）
│        ▼
② src/bindings.cc :: all_to_all_4d_autograd → all_to_all_4d
│    require_cuda + CUDAGuard 后调 run(...)
│        ▼
③ src/bindings.cc :: run
│    ├─ prepare(...)                     ← 全部校验 + 取 plan/窗口（必须先于第一个屏障）
│    │    ├─ group->check_alive() / group->prune_owned()          [src/group.cc]
│    │    ├─ require_cuda / require_group_device
│    │    ├─ group->plan(sizes, mode, dtype, seq, head)           [src/group.cc]
│    │    │    ├─ make_dims(...)                                  [src/group.cc] 形状与 splits 交叉校验
│    │    │    └─ ulysses::build_plan(dims, mode, elem_size)      [src/a2a_plan.cc] ← 纯主机寻址
│    │    ├─ 输出三态：caller 的 out / at::empty 新分配
│    │    └─ group->window(kSyncWindow, dtype, window_numel)      [src/group.cc]
│    │         （首次或需增长时 → allocate()：对称内存分配 + rendezvous）
│    ├─ transfer_on_stream(...)
│    │    ├─ fast_barrier(stream, win->flag_ptrs, rank)           [src/barrier.cu]  开局屏障
│    │    ├─ launch_a2a_ce(x.data_ptr(), win->peer_ptrs, plan,    [src/transfer.cu]
│    │    │                  xfer_stream, rank, stream)
│    │    │    └─ 对 plan.ops 每个 CopyOp: issue_copy(...)       [src/transfer.cu]
│    │    │         → cudaMemcpy2DAsync / cudaMemcpy3DAsync
│    │    └─ fast_barrier(...)                                    [src/barrier.cu]  收尾屏障
│    └─ copy_out(call, stream, rank)      [src/bindings.cc]      copying 路径才有：
│         窗口 → 输出张量的一次平坦 D2D 拷贝
│        ▼
④ 返回 y（zero-copy 路径下 y 就是窗口本身，copy_out 被跳过）
```

三条贯穿性的设计约束（后面各讲反复引用）：

1. **校验全部先于第一个屏障**：被拒绝的参数不能让本 rank 停在屏障上等一个根本不会来的对端（[src/bindings.cc:L87-L88](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L87-L88)）。
2. **设备层不算偏移、不知道地址从哪来**：`launch_a2a_ce` 的偏移全部来自 `plan.ops`，peer 地址由调用者传入——这正是 transfer.hpp 头注释 [include/fast_ulysses/transfer.hpp:L1-L5](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/transfer.hpp#L1-L5) 说的「以此把所有通信库挡在这个翻译单元之外」。
3. **状态都在 C++ 组对象里**：plan 缓存（`std::map<PlanKey, A2APlan>`）、窗口表、暂存池都是 `UlyssesGroup` 的成员，Python 侧每次调用只是无状态转发。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**第①跳：Python 转发。** [python/fast_ulysses/group.py:L111-L132](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L111-L132) 定义 `all_to_all_4d`；无 `out=` 时它只有一行实质调用——把 `_handle`（构造时经 [python/fast_ulysses/group.py:L87-L89](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L87-L89) 创建的 `torch.classes.fast_ulysses.UlyssesGroup`）连同张量与参数交给注册算子。

**第②跳：算子注册与 autograd 入口。** 算子 schema 注册在 [src/bindings.cc:L718-L726](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L718-L726)：`all_to_all_4d` 注册了 `CompositeExplicitAutograd`（计算）、`Autograd`（[src/bindings.cc:L584-L605](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L584-L605)，处理反向与前向 AD）和 `Meta` 三个 key。无梯度需求时 autograd 入口直接走 [src/bindings.cc:L253-L270](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L253-L270) 的 `all_to_all_4d`，它取当前 CUDA 流后调 `run`。

**第③跳 run 的三段式。** [src/bindings.cc:L225-L241](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L225-L241)：`run = prepare + transfer_on_stream + (可选) copy_out`。

- `prepare`（[src/bindings.cc:L89-L174](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L89-L174)）：校验链 + 从组里取 plan 与窗口，并把「输入/输出与窗口的字节区间是否重叠」也查掉。
- `transfer_on_stream`（[src/bindings.cc:L194-L211](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L194-L211)）：开局屏障（写者等读者）→ `launch_a2a_ce` → 收尾屏障。
- `copy_out`（[src/bindings.cc:L216-L223](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/bindings.cc#L216-L223)）：一次 `cudaMemcpyAsync`（D2D），把窗口内容搬到调用者持有的输出张量。

**第③跳内：plan 的来路。** [src/group.cc:L167-L196](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L167-L196) 的 `UlyssesGroup::plan` 以 `(sizes, seq, head, mode, dtype)` 为缓存键，未命中时先经 [src/group.cc:L45-L136](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L45-L136) 的 `make_dims`（形状 4D、dtype 白名单、16 字节对齐、splits 交叉校验、偶均分特例），再调 `build_plan`（[src/group.cc:L191-L195](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L191-L195)）——从这里进入 4.2 的纯主机层。

**第③跳内：窗口的来路。** [src/group.cc:L255-L267](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L255-L267) 的 `window` 按 `(role, dtype)` 查缓存，尺寸不够则「先删旧再分配」，最终落到 [src/group.cc:L207-L253](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/group.cc#L207-L253) 的 `allocate`：torch 对称内存分配 + rendezvous 收集每个 peer 的地址 + 清零握手区（u4-l1 的主题）。

**第③跳底：两次设备调用。** 传输与屏障是一对：

- [src/transfer.cu:L68-L126](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/transfer.cu#L68-L126) `launch_a2a_ce`：peer 按 `rank ^ k` 异或序枚举（非 2 幂 world_size 再补一次扫描），远端拷贝串行发在 `xfer` 专用流上，本 rank 自份额发在调用者流上，最后用事件把两流汇合。每个 `CopyOp` 经 [src/transfer.cu:L26-L52](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/transfer.cu#L26-L52) 的 `issue_copy` 变成一次 `cudaMemcpy2DAsync`（`depth<=1`）或 `cudaMemcpy3DAsync`（batch 折叠）。
- [src/barrier.cu:L53-L67](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/barrier.cu#L53-L67) `fast_barrier`：`world_size==1` 直接返回（u1-l3 见过的「ws=1 跳过屏障」就在这行）；否则发射 [src/barrier.cu:L31-L49](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/barrier.cu#L31-L49) 的单块自旋内核 `barrier_kernel`，用内联 PTX 的 release/acquire 指令发布与等待 epoch（u5-l3 逐行精读）。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：亲手把 4.3.2 的骨架补成一张「每个节点带文件 + 函数名 + 行号」的调用链卡片，并用两个无 GPU 手段交叉验证其中两跳。

**操作步骤**：

1. 从 [python/fast_ulysses/group.py:L129-L132](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L129-L132) 出发，用编辑器的「跳转到定义」或 Grep 依次追每一跳，把 4.3.2 的图抄录成自己的版本，并在每个节点补上行号。
2. 验证「plan 跳」：运行 4.2.4 的 `a2a_plan_debug` 脚本，确认它输出的 `ops` 与主链上 `group->plan()` 缓存的是同一份计算（同一个 `build_plan`）。
3. 验证「ws=1 跳过屏障」：读 [src/barrier.cu:L55-L57](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/barrier.cu#L55-L57)，确认 `ws == 1` 时 `fast_barrier` 直接 return——这解释了 u1-l3 里「world_size=1 时哪些行为仍然成立」的观察。
4. 在图中用两种颜色（或标记）区分**每次调用都要走的节点**（prepare、两个屏障、launch_a2a_ce）与**只有首次/增长时才走的节点**（`make_dims`+`build_plan` 未命中、`allocate`）。

**需要观察的现象**：plan 命中缓存时 `make_dims` / `build_plan` 完全不执行；窗口已存在且够大时 `allocate` 不执行。即稳态调用只剩「校验 + 两次屏障 + 拷贝发射 + copy_out」。
